name: humid_air_1691_whf_recheck_refusal_reported
description: A refusal found by a re-check (not by the window opening) is reported too: the open window's re-check sees humid air and writes the Activity row
notes: Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: removing the report from the re-check path (_log_nat_vent_not_engaged) makes 20:30 read paused instead of nat_vent_humid_skip. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: the fan stays off on a muggy evening and the Activity report never says why.

events.note: Outdoor warmer than the house: no fan start by temperature.
Window opens: paused (temperature gate fails, so no humid refusal yet).
Outdoor cools below the house, still humid (dew point ~67F): the paused-by-door re-check asks the start question.

assertions.reason: Outdoor warmer than inside: the window pauses HVAC.
The re-check would start the fan by temperature; the humid-air guard refuses it and reports it.
